title: Gemini 3.5 Pro Has Not Been Released Yet, Google May Skip the Wait and Turn to Gemini 4

content_html:
On August 11, according to the latest report by industry analysis firm SemiAnalysis, Google may have put on hold its originally planned Gemini 3.5 Pro model and might be filling the market gap caused by the delay of its flagship model by promoting the Gemini 4 series in advance. Previously, Google had drawn attention due to the delayed release of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with reports indicating that the model still needs optimization in some key capabilities, especially in code-related performance.

At the Google I/O developer conference in May 2026, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai stated that Gemini 3.5 Pro was expected to be launched in June, but the model has not officially been released yet. Subsequently, during Alphabet's second-quarter earnings call, Pichai continued to emphasize Google's progress in cutting-edge AI and expressed confidence in the development of the Gemini series models.

SemiAnalysis pointed out that the current Gemini series is facing competitive pressure in some AI capability evaluations and believes its development speed lags behind some leading models. It was previously reported that Gemini 3.5 Pro briefly appeared on the Arena platform and was removed about 30 minutes after going online, sparking discussions about the model's testing status.

According to reports, Google's delay in releasing Gemini 3.5 Pro was mainly related to model performance optimization, including enterprise-level application scenarios such as code generation. Google has stated that the model is still in the testing phase and is being evaluated with partners.

If SemiAnalysis's assessment proves correct, Google may be adjusting the Gemini product timeline, allocating more resources to the next-generation Gemini 4 series to cope with the accelerating model iteration from OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI laboratories. Currently, competition among large models has shifted from simply launching new versions to a comprehensive contest involving capabilities, costs, application ecosystems, and R&D efficiency.

content_html_zh:
8月11日，根据行业分析公司SemiAnalysis的最新报告，谷歌可能已经搁置了原定计划的Gemini 3.5 Pro机型，并可能通过提前推广Gemini 4系列来填补旗舰机型延迟推出带来的市场空白。 此前，谷歌因Gemini 3.5 Pro延迟发布而引起关注，有报道称该模型在一些关键能力上仍需优化，尤其是代码相关的性能。

在 2026 年 5 月的 Google I/O 开发者大会上，Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai 表示，Gemini 3.5 Pro 预计将于 6 月推出，但该型号尚未正式发布。 随后，在 Alphabet 第二季度财报电话会议上，皮查伊继续强调谷歌在尖端 AI 方面的进展，并对 Gemini 系列机型的发展表示信心。

SemiAnalysis指出，目前Gemini系列在一些AI能力评估中面临竞争压力，并认为其发展速度落后于一些领先机型。 此前有报道称，Gemini 3.5 Pro曾短暂出现在Arena平台上，并在上线约30分钟后被下架，引发了对该机型测试状态的讨论。

据报道，谷歌推迟发布Gemini 3.5 Pro主要与模型性能优化有关，包括代码生成等企业级应用场景。 谷歌表示，该模型仍处于测试阶段，正在与合作伙伴一起评估。

如果SemiAnalysis的评估被证明是正确的，谷歌可能会调整Gemini产品时间表，将更多资源分配给下一代Gemini 4系列，以应对OpenAI、Anthropic等AI实验室加速的模型迭代。 当前，大机型之间的竞争已经从单纯推出新版本转向能力、成本、应用生态、研发效率等综合较量。
